updates.title: Fairy 1.0.3 // English Voice by Default
updates.notes: New Fairy profiles default to en-US replies and English Edge-TTS, with English microphone priority. Existing saved user language choices are preserved; Configure Language is still required before first Reboot.

updates.title: Fairy 1.0.2 // Independent UI Language Default
updates.notes: Default interface to English when no UI language has been selected, independent of the reply/TTS or microphone languages. Existing explicit PT-BR/Spanish UI choices remain respected.
